source_disposition: No new source reading is introduced. The proposal rests on already-registered claims: SC-GEN-01 (the draft disavows the belief that nature repeated a generation three times), SC-GEN-02 (the 2+1 replacement with two true families and one effective imposter), SC-GEN-04 (the imposter is explicitly not a true generation), SC-CHI-50 (the theory has no chirality for the anomaly to attach to), and SC-CHI-51 (GU must produce an effectively chiral world via a VEV in a Dirac-Rarita-Schwinger-like operator). The comparator-routing method's forks 1 and 4 govern the anomaly and family-index comparators.
claim_ceiling: Verdict-kind re-typing proposal only. No evidence changes, no computation is revisited, no row moves toward SAME, and every affected row keeps its exact distance and revival trigger. A re-typed row remains a negative result; only the column changes, from OVER_DETERMINED to DIFFERS, where the row's own mapping grade already reads ROUTE_KILL. Separately and outside this delta, LT-GR8 was typed NONE-NOT-A-KILL as a regression repair rather than a verdict change: it is an accepted external benchmark target whose kill_scope field states what a future realization-packet failure would bound, not a kill the row performs. It was added in this session and had pushed the kill-target gate RED at 9 against baseline 8; the gate is now ok at 8.

proposed_effect.summary: Verdict changes proposed, not applied: re-type AC-F3 from OVER_DETERMINED/GENUINE_FALSIFICATION to DIFFERS/ROUTE_KILLED to match its own EXACT_ROUTE_KILL mapping grade and its sibling AC-F4, which carries DIFFERS/ROUTE_KILLED for the same 3-primary target; review LT-GR1b and RA-D2 on the same criterion. Also proposes target_claim typing for the remaining kill-bearing rows so the kill-target gate ratchet can be driven to zero.
